verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly from left to right in the leaderboard format: phone with its circle, then brand, a one-line headline and the tagline, then the badges stacked together and the CTA. Its flaws are the phone squeezed small and clipped at the bottom of the canvas, the badges sitting a bit loose in the middle, and a CTA almost touching the right edge. B is cramped and jumbled: SOLSTICE floats on its own to the left of a headline that wraps to two lines, the CTA is jammed under a badge in a tight cluster with the SUMMER ONLY badge left alone at top right, the right side and gaps are dead space, and the phone is clipped at the top and bottom.
